header.title: Settings
header.description: Choose what Mirror may collect. These preferences stay on this Mac.

privacy.title: Capture exclusions
privacy.description: One value per line. Matching apps, windows, and domains are discarded before local storage.

blockedApplications.label: Blocked applications
blockedApplications.hint: Select installed applications that Mirror must never capture.

blockedWindowTitles.label: Blocked window title keywords
blockedWindowTitles.hint: A window is ignored when its title contains any listed phrase.

blockedDomains.label: Blocked domains
blockedDomains.hint: Used for browser events when browser integration is enabled. Subdomains are included.

captureWindowTitles.label: Collect window titles
captureWindowTitles.description: Turn this off to keep only application-level activity.

messages.restartRequired: Restart Mirror to activate the updated desktop bridge.
messages.saved: Saved locally. New filters apply to the next focus session.
